name: Kyrgyzstan
famous_for: Tian Shan mountain range ('Celestial Mountains'), pristine alpine Lake Issyk-Kul, yurt dwelling nomad life, and eagle hunting.
tourists: Over 6.9M visitors; famous for Song-Kul horse riding treks, Ala Archa National Park, and Sulaiman-Too sacred mountain.
must_know: The traditional felt Yurt (Boz-ui) is so central to Kyrgyz identity that its wooden crown (Tunduk) appears on the national flag.
fun_fact: The Epic of Manas is one of the world's longest epic poems with over 500,000 poetic lines passed down orally by Manaschi bards.
